stage0070_04:r_caaab7bad760e16d.text:
$$ベック$$
「Pathetic, Sideburns.
　You said you'd handle the front line,
　only to come running back like this?」

stage0070_04:r_99b162aa6aa286a2.text:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Shuuut it, Beard!
　Call it unexpected resistance!」

stage0070_04:r_58fb02434a1c40b2.text:
$$ベック$$
「Hey, don't tell me you've forgotten
　the favor I did saving you in Hong Kong.」

stage0070_04:r_1c0f94acd5a8a143.text:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Too bad for you.
　That's thanks to the length of my sideburns.」

stage0070_04:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
$$ゲイツ$$
「That's why I survived,
　fit as a fiddle from head to toe, as you see!」

stage0070_04:r_3bc300bbdc277d82.text:
$$ベック$$
「OK, OK!
　Then I'll rip out those sideburns
　you're so proud of!」

stage0070_04:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$ゲイツ$$
「I'll rip your beard out by the roots before that!」

stage0070_04:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
$$カン・ユー$$
「Enough, both of you!
　Don't forget it was I who took you in
　when you had nowhere else to go!」

stage0070_04:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:
$$ファイヤバグ$$ Trooper
「That's enough.
　First, we carry out Project Princess.」

stage0070_04:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$$ファイヤバグ$$ Trooper
「As the $$再世戦争$$ ended, 《$$姫$$》 left us...」

stage0070_04:r_f951916061232dcd.text:
$$ファイヤバグ$$ Trooper
「Our kind and lovely $$姫$$...
　must have hesitated to drag us
　into a fight with no tomorrow...」

stage0070_04:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
$$ファイヤバグ$$ Trooper
「But since then, $$ファイヤバグ$$ has known nothing but hardship.」

stage0070_04:r_44f4742c3dcce39a.text:
$$ファイヤバグ$$ Trooper
「This is simply because we lacked a leader to guide us.」

stage0070_04:r_9e701cdeb3842c21.text:
$$ファイヤバグ$$ Trooper
「Noble, strong... and a little wicked...
　We need a $$姫$$!」

stage0070_04:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$ファイヤバグ$$ Trooper
「After rigorous screening, we chose a new $$姫$$...
　Welcoming her in is Project Princess!
　And now is the moment of its fulfillment!」

stage0070_04:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$$ファイヤバグ$$ Trooper
「All units, ready!
　Let's all call out her name!!」

stage0070_04:r_09d0fcc600cdd3df.text:
$$テッサ$$
「I-I don't know anything about it!」

stage0070_04:r_9c206d19bfda4bd5.text:
$$ファイヤバグ$$ Trooper
「And a little wicked!」

stage0070_04:r_6e558bc69acf5bf3.text:
$$ファイヤバグ$$ Trooper
「Not to mention outstanding command skills!
　$$テレサ・テスタロッサ$$...!
　She's the one fit to be our new $$姫$$!」

stage0070_04:r_6fd86c96891ea942.text:
$$カレン$$
「$$デュオ$$ and everyone else are covered in wounds, but...」

stage0070_04:r_d80a9688790ed583.text:
$$五飛$$
「But what do we do?
　It'll be a few more minutes before
　$c's main force arrives.」

stage0070_04:r_708bea61e3c43ada.text:
$$かなめ$$
「It's all right!
　There's a hero of justice right here!」

stage0070_04:r_ff6f8bdca2dd2bc9.text:
$$クラン$$
「How many times, $$アルト$$!
　That's $$ボン太くん#robot$$!
　Say the 'kun', you forehead dork!」

stage0070_04:r_567b361a454c4b73.text:
$$五飛$$
「Some kind of powered suit...!
　Who's piloting it!?」

stage0070_04:r_79f2664edb1af798.text:
$$トロワ$$
「No... that thing is packed full of a child's dreams.」

stage0070_04:r_1c5aa0d15ae24846.text:
$$甲児$$
「But $$ボン太くん#robot$$ alone won't be enough...!」

stage0070_04:r_53bb64ee17750ee2.text:
$$ボス$$
「Don't you go forgetting about us!!」

stage0070_04:r_7a7add80fde475ba.text:
$$甲児$$
「$$ボス$$!
　You brought Borot along!?」

stage0070_04:r_b2befefdbed1393d.text:
$$クロス$$
「Hey, you lot!
　Make up for slacking off with some hard work!」

stage0070_04:r_a12e3e130d896ff7.text:
$$ジャンゴ$$
「So where'd you punks run off to?
　Got something to do with fireworks on the hill?」

stage0070_04:r_b6f7b219eb4bd64b.text:
$$ムチャ$$
「N-no, I've no idea what you mean...!」

stage0070_04:r_91bf33c27ad39f0a.text:
$$お菊$$
「Oh, never mind.
　We'll help too, so do your best.」

stage0070_04:r_ce1b55e526b6277a.text:
$$安$$
「Oh... $$先生$$'s fired up to kill too, huh!」

stage0070_04:r_c304df6888eb78f7.text:
$$クロス$$
「If Atami gets burned down while the boss lady's away,
　we'll have no face left to show!
　Don't screw this up, boys!!」

stage0070_04:r_c26958634526e597.text:
$$ローレライ$$
「Do your best, $$ボン太くん#robot$$!」

stage0070_04:r_48f49f6728c15612.text:
$n
「Those guys...!
　They mean to turn Atami into a battlefield!?」

stage0070_04:r_0ebc5a6f1e0f81bf.text:
???
「You have a strong sense of justice, huh.」

stage0070_04:r_f02c37d91387d0ad.text:
$n
「...I've never really thought much about justice...」

stage0070_04:r_6bbd5a3c5afb87e0.text:
???
「I think that's fine.
　Just live as you feel.」

stage0070_04:r_643b6eebfc0186b3.text:
???
「You saved me from that thug earlier.
　Now it's my turn to help you.」

stage0070_04:r_32eb462c1b4999cb.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「$$アンナロッタ・ストールス$$...
　That is my name.」

stage0070_04:r_b76524cd840e1d37.text:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Ha-ha! $$ボン太くん#robot$$!
　Even you can't handle this many at once!」

stage0070_04:r_730ffe18400abfc2.text:
$$ボス$$
「Don't you go forgetting about me!」

stage0070_04:r_ffe0fca26da5cd38.text:
$$ベック$$
「That's a joke fit for a comedy robot!
　You really crack me up!」

stage0070_04:r_bfb27f9eb2f7073e.text:
$$ボス$$
「Shut it!
　You lot are basically comic relief yourselves!」

stage0070_04:r_859dfa27bcaafe30.text:
$$カン・ユー$$
「Wait, you two!
　Something's coming!!」

stage0070_04:r_8eaf6f3098ffed12.text:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Oh my?
　That's the machine... Geminis's $$アンナロッタ$$, was it...
　Did you come to help us out?」

stage0070_04:r_cf507214fe955d75.text:
$$ゲイツ$$
「But too baaad!
　$$ゲイツ$$ gave Amalgam the slip
　and went freelance, you see!」

stage0070_04:r_2113dcbabdfc758a.text:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Freedom! Aaand, justice!
　$$ゲイツ$$'s destiny, you might say!」

stage0070_04:r_5b992878fee054b5.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「...A city burned without mercy...」

stage0070_04:r_4a14ec0c511c7f0d.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「I know I have no right to say something like this...」

stage0070_04:r_20cf167c0ec0d4d5.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「But today, just this once, I'll say it!
　I will not forgive this kind of savagery!」

stage0070_04:r_e350fa099c1ab072.text:
$$カン・ユー$$
「If you get in our way, I won't go easy on you!」

stage0070_04:r_c33bd700553abf91.text:
$$ボス$$
「What do we do, he asks...
　Like we can take on both $$ファイヤバグ$$
　and the Geminis commander at once!」

stage0070_04:r_feee5c91826230e1.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「Don't worry.
　I've no intention of touching you lot today.」

stage0070_04:r_f8736aaaa216c766.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
（Maybe I've felt this way ever since
　meeting that black-haired boy...
　Those eyes... looked a bit like the captain's...）

stage0070_04:r_d1ec2522c87c361d.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
（Farewell, boy...
　In the end, I came here meaning to unwind,
　but it only left me more confused than before...）

stage0070_04:r_1c208ca0cbf26f28.text:
$$モニカ$$
「Aah! I should've gone to $$くろがね屋$$ too!」

stage0070_04:r_8d8f065c932da30a.text:
$$ムチャ$$
「...we don't even register, it seems.」

stage0070_04:r_f5432119677514f7.text:
$$キャシー$$
「Captain, what should we do about
　Geminis's $$アンナロッタ・ストールス$$?」

stage0070_04:r_4e5c8e989c4a7691.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「She's cooperating with us.
　Right now, taking down $$ファイヤバグ$$ comes first.」

stage0070_04:r_adec86483b13599a.text:
$$キャシー$$
「Then, we'll launch the members we've taken aboard.」

stage0070_04:r_2cf701bbcde3ec13.text:
$$ベック$$
「So you've come, $$ロジャー・スミス$$, and your little friends!」

stage0070_04:r_c17c58fdba72005e.text:
$$カン・ユー$$
「$$キリコ$$!
　Today, I'll finally settle this with you!」

stage0070_04:r_1fe8564d2b959317.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「$$キリコ$$...
　We've both got our hands full with weirdos dogging us.」

stage0070_04:r_4b1247bd3ca4905d.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「So $c's main force has arrived.」

stage0070_04:r_d91d4bc2d52b61c4.text:
$n
「Guess we pictured each other differently off the field.」

stage0070_04:r_0c8ea89b07432421.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「I never imagined that boy
　was the Imitation's pilot.」

stage0070_04:r_4dbfba00ba7744ee.text:
$n
「...Let me say this now.
　I have no intention of forgiving you,
　Geminis and $$ガドライト・メオンサム$$.」

stage0070_04:r_b1e38da4e8775ffe.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「Don't say any more than that.
　If you'll indulge my sentimentality, that's enough.」

stage0070_04:r_2acc8ade0cc6dfa2.text:
$n
「Just for today, I'll let that person go...」

stage0070_04:r_3dad695c99e9e052.text:
$$甲児$$
「...Can't be helped.
　We owe that guy one, after all.」

stage0070_04:r_66d4ae3a21caf881.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Tch...!
　Never thought we'd team up with that Geminis commander.」

stage0070_04:r_0c18da7b3a37825d.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「...Silence.
　Even alone, I have no problem fighting you all.」

stage0070_04:r_63249745ffae61b6.text:
$$刹那$$
「Stop.
　Now is not the time for that.」

stage0070_04:r_abdb034ae8509702.text:
$$アムロ$$
「That conversation waits.
　Right now, we defend Atami.」

stage0070_04:r_3ff2e21207d1d1d3.text:
$$ゲイツ$$
「What's this? Little $c, our hero,
　teaming up with the worst mastermind
　around, the Geminis～?」

stage0070_04:r_e51ecf6d6aa42e75.text:
$$アマタ$$
「What in the world is that guy...?」

stage0070_04:r_47ddabb7b60131c2.text:
$$ガムリン$$
「He's clearly not normal, just from the look of him...」

stage0070_04:r_b025267f22788233.text:
$$マオ$$
「He's a member of Amalgam's leadership.
　...though from how things look, make that 'former.'」

stage0070_04:r_ec1a06a7023bf72c.text:
$$クルーゾー$$
「But his machine has a Lambda Driver,
　and he's skilled himself.
　Don't let your guard down.」

stage0070_04:r_8805f96e52aaa462.text:
$$青山$$
「Good grief...
　If Crowe were here, he'd cover his eyes
　at how far the $$ファイヤバグ$$ has strayed.」

stage0070_04:r_124591cb154fae64.text:
$$ロックオン$$
「Knowing him,
　he'd gladly send them off to the next world.」

stage0070_04:r_7bdb6fecc8b3bde8.text:
$$デュオ$$
「Can't help it.
　Guess we'll do it in his place this time.」

stage0070_04:r_b4bc9e9435b58e6f.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「All units, cooperate with $$ボン太くん#pilot$$
　and $$アンナロッタ$$, and intercept the $$ファイヤバグ$$.」

stage0070_04:r_a9227573166977a9.text:
$n
（$$アンナロッタ$$...
　This is our first, and last, fight together）

stage0070_04:r_b0600ab9a9e8559d.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「...What... am I even doing...」

stage0070_04:r_07f53c816e0a51f5.text:
$$ヨーコ$$
「Every last one of them's stubborn, huh.」

stage0070_04:r_2d09c6f6a2d990ea.text:
$$シモン$$
「If those guys are still alive,
　then Crowe's gotta be alive somewhere too.」

stage0070_04:r_0476ffd10c764b0e.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「That goes for Land and Setsuko too, probably.」

stage0070_04:r_e370696b8936b08c.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「Don't say my name so casually,
　$F.」

stage0070_04:r_9d7b02c5e728b7aa.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「Today was just a whim of mine.
　Next time we meet, I'll destroy that
　pathetic imitation of yours.」

stage0070_04:r_9af213fc64e0afec.text:
$n
「If you think you can do it, go ahead and try.
　If you're the ones starting this, that's fine by me.」

stage0070_04:r_0c705091f748360e.text:
$$カレン$$
「No matter how cool you act, that's not gonna work.」

stage0070_04:r_a072aa25e5f521e0.text:
$$クルーゾー$$
「Is he guarding $$千鳥かなめ$$ and
　Captain Testarossa...?」

stage0070_04:r_24e1a808a1609a1a.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「...Some things are better left unknown...」

stage0070_04:r_03b5db9ce98fb8d6.text:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Whoa there!
　If not for my sideburns, that would've been fatal!」

stage0070_04:r_3915fb4102f1c1dd.text:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Well then, everyone!
　When my sideburns reach my shoulders, let's wed!」

stage0070_04:r_1cc233cbc8c80af7.text:
$$マオ$$
「This is bad...
　From how he's acting, it looks like he'll
　keep coming after us from here on.」

stage0070_04:r_e180b22d18f48d38.text:
$$ベック$$
「Damn it!
　Seems the Victory Deluxe
　just doesn't have the power!」

stage0070_04:r_e598c2a0b27e7f50.text:
$$ベック$$
「Remember this, $$ロジャー・スミス$$!
　Next time, I'll definitely get my revenge!」

stage0070_04:r_4d2a9066c4e7b27f.text:
$$モーム$$
「So it seems, Master $$ロジャー$$.」

stage0070_04:r_10340119af3ed6db.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「If I worried about every villain's parting shot,
　I couldn't do this job as a negotiator.」

stage0070_04:r_4f0aca6deda07883.text:
$$カン・ユー$$
「Damn it all!
　It's because I got dragged into some worthless plan!」

stage0070_04:r_8fe40600ce62dfbc.text:
$$カン・ユー$$
「$$キリコ$$!
　If you think today's battle showed my
　real strength, you're dead wrong!」

stage0070_04:r_d73c21f119847e35.text:
$$スザク$$
「Maybe you could listen to him a little?」

stage0070_04:r_89766f5ffaa912d4.text:
$$キリコ$$
「I'm sick of hearing that kind of talk from him.」

stage0070_04:r_2ddff5064af78db4.text:
$$かなめ$$
「No way, that's just not happening...」

stage0070_04:r_050d0532c4b24bfe.text:
$$安$$
「Come on, come on, here we go!
　Make way for the Kurogane Five!」

stage0070_04:r_d583fcea31bdad2e.text:
$$クロス$$
「Anyone who gets in the way is getting flattened!」

stage0070_04:r_475f7653621a91b5.text:
$$ジャンゴ$$
「Anyone who sees us is getting crushed!」

stage0070_04:r_d69dc027cba3003f.text:
$$お菊$$
「Come on then, whoever wants to die first!
　I'll send you straight to paradise!」

stage0070_04:r_1f418b5594cea300.text:
$$ムチャ$$
「We're basically just legs for them at this point!」

stage0070_04:r_f87fb889124bfaef.text:
$$ボス$$
「Shut up!
　Screw it, I'm going all out!!」

stage0070_04:r_79c90de32a79212d.text:
$$ボス$$
「I'll show you!
　The miracle collab between the
　Kurogane Five and the three of us!!」

stage0070_04:r_33f7fd55913419e8.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
（That boy's eyes...
　They're just like the Captain's... no, like ours...）

stage0070_04:r_473d9a88b4ca96e7.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
（But there's no going back now...
　We have no home planet to return to...!）

stage0070_04:r_4de6ac85c63bac12.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
（Damn... I can't believe it...
　That boy is $F...）

stage0070_04:r_4c92652c9b1adf6f.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
（What am I... doing...!
　He's the enemy...!）

stage0070_04:r_ce90563a934d49fb.text:
$n
（$$アンナロッタ・ストールス$$...）

stage0070_04:r_4fb296e63cb1fb46.text:
$$スズネ$$
「$n, focus on the enemy ahead, now!」

stage0070_04:r_9dc59affd40f32fc.text:
$$スズネ$$
「I understand how you feel.
　Don't let anger or hate blind you to what matters.」

stage0070_04:r_d36072babd12aeb4.text:
$$ゲイツ$$
「Whoaaa!
　Adorable! You're adorable, $$ボン太くん#pilot$$!」

stage0070_04:r_fae689f2a1057b61.text:
$$ゲイツ$$
「I'll slaughter you right now,
　skin you, and lick you all over!」

stage0070_04:r_42a3149105314ab8.text:
$$ベック$$
「Found you, a rare catch!
　I'll nab you and stuff you for a trophy!」

stage0070_04:r_d441e6cc908ac01b.text:
$$ベック$$
「Ha ha ha! Did that make you mad?
　Even your sass is kinda cute!」

stage0070_04:r_2c7af4c55d8ac938.text:
$$ベック$$
「What'd you say, you punk!
　That's no way to talk to the genius $$ベック$$!」

stage0070_04:r_653b741d07545dff.text:
$$ダヴ$$
「Bro... can you actually talk to that bear...?」

stage0070_04:r_d584d4b5af55b1cf.text:
$$Ｔボーン$$
「Hard to believe, but it looks that way...」

stage0070_04:r_db0ee69ece206fcd.text:
$$ベック$$
「This kind of thing is all about feeling!
　Let's go, $$ボン太くん#pilot$$!!」

stage0070_04:r_7980fd37141d88d0.text:
$$カン・ユー$$
（What is this... I've never felt anything like it...）

stage0070_04:r_ac21212c36d2b9ad.text:
$$カン・ユー$$
（Is this... could it be my heart's racing...）

stage0070_04:r_a26e2108358af7a4.text:
$$甲児$$
（Mom...
　What are you doing out here all alone...）

stage0070_04:r_a8118b2e37aa1382.text:
$$甲児$$
（The Mechanical Beast army's been
　wiped out... So what is Mom fighting...）

stage0070_04:r_017a56991b7b8ca4.text:
$$ミサト$$
「$$シンジ$$, the enemy is right in
　front of you! Focus!」

stage0070_04:r_0149e3a5f2e5ef78.text:
$$アスカ$$
「Daddy's Boy!
　What are you grinning about!」

stage0070_04:r_3ad10e705167a3fa.text:
$$アスカ$$
「Y-you don't mean...!
　You're remembering that hot spring thing earlier...」

stage0070_04:r_bdc546b199c80996.text:
$$シンジ$$
「T-that's not it at all!
　Let's go!」

stage0070_04:r_f42017dfce31dea9.text:
$$ファ$$
「What are you thinking, $$カミーユ$$!
　The enemy's right in front of us!」

stage0070_04:r_ef7426919f628d8a.text:
$$ファ$$
「You don't mean...!
　You're thinking about that hot spring thing...!」

stage0070_04:r_9e994a4b926d9906.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「T-that's not true!
　I didn't see anything!」

stage0070_04:r_ffae76d2a77abf5a.text:
$$ファ$$
「You've really disappointed me, $$カミーユ$$!」

stage0070_04:r_fd6bdf7910d7d925.text:
$$シン$$
「That $$カミーユ$$ guy... what a lucky perv...!」

stage0070_04:r_3fe2078328753c16.text:
FB Soldier
「To us, who'd lost our $$姫|lc$$, an angel appeared...
　Her name: $$テレサ・テスタロッサ$$...!」

stage0070_04:r_c66844158d1ce600.text:
FB Soldier
「For your sake, we can die!」

stage0070_04:r_d037ecbc1e348dc9.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Then please go ahead and do that already!」

stage0070_04:r_bcd53d14c4785426.text:
FB Soldier
「With a new $$姫|lc$$, we are reborn!
　That's right! Today's the birth of a new $$ファイヤバグ$$!」

stage0070_04:r_9ca55ea7feca954a.text:
FB Soldier
「Now, $$テレサ・テスタロッサ$$!
　Give us your orders!」

stage0070_04:r_554ae12c4c170253.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Just turn right around and sink into the sea, please!」

stage0070_04:r_fa59c6df081e6ae4.text:
FB Soldier
「T-$$テッサ$$-tan...!
　$$テッサ$$-tan! $$テッサ$$-tan!!」

stage0070_04:r_aa5d235c78ebe19f.text:
$$かなめ$$
「That's an intense love call, huh...」

stage0070_04:r_0b3b19cddb871f90.text:
$$テッサ$$
「I-I don't want a guy like that calling me $$テッサ$$!」
